fields.native_rule: ExecutionEvent.identity: planner-event-v1 content identity; verify full retained event bytes.
ExecutionEvent carrying actual PREPARE result/admission; PASS enum or report label is not an event type.
Retained actual typed admission operand, including actual result, exact knowledge and dossier bindings; no guessed materialization inputs.
ExecutionEvent.parent_event; predecessor identity in the retained ledger, not report chronology or a new A03 identity.
Predecessor.after_snapshot equals ExecutionEvent.parent_snapshot; not a separate field.
ExecutionEvent.parent_snapshot; exact state with applicable current PREPARE inputs.
ExecutionEvent.after_snapshot; coherently linked accepted dossier/decision-readiness state.
Exact event-bearing PersistenceBundle identity plus /bundle/events, or existing native GenesisLedger ID if actually applicable; ordinary bundles have no separate LedgerId.
First native event identity; do not invent GENESIS or a root from report sequence.
ExecutionEvent.sequence and exact /bundle/events index agree. Report sequence=3 is not native membership.
Previous retained event equals parent_event; canonical Action history connects the actual acquisition prefix.
If descendant history is supplied, next.parent_event=event.identity and next.parent_snapshot=event.after_snapshot. No successor required at a retained head.
Actual native ledger root-to-A04-to-retained-head continuity; preserve event order.
Event binds actual SuppliedResult/action/outcome/expected_snapshot or exact native admission operand; there is no standalone ActionResult record ID on SuppliedResult.
Exact E2-K-PREPARE KnowledgeRecord bytes and dossier binding; KnowledgeId/content/dossier/event identities remain separate domains.
E2-QUALIFICATION-ONLY from native Snapshot.context and payload/provenance, not a fabricated event field.
Original E2-CANONICAL-BASELINE-1 or an independently acceptable authoritative boundary; no prospective-lineage splice.
E2-GENERATION-1 for original retained context; generation from canonical context/provenance.
Exact source/content/provenance of Action, actual output, dossier and admitted validations, coherently pinned by retained state/bundle.
SuppliedResult and ExecutionEvent have no command ID; inspect HEAD.command if retained, do not invent one.
Native occurrence/state trace connects actual PREPARE result to accepted dossier/handoff; equal control or name alone is insufficient.

scope_rule: Canonical history or already explicitly accepted replacement evidence only. T02 capability qualification alone and snapshot-only handoff cannot satisfy native ancestry.
